scope: Reference appendices in the two current manuscripts, matching Markdown, verified historical URLs, proposed v2 standards/v3 enterprise destinations and documentary identity only.
tree_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over ordinal relative-path sorted UTF-8 path TAB decimal-bytes TAB sha256 LF records, excluding this record only; transient Word owner files excluded.

workspace_selection_check.method: Existing inspect(root, strict=False) on a byte-matched persistent-file scratch copy; not a runtime test or release gate.

limits: Secret-pattern scan is limited, not a complete security audit.

Local machine folders .git, .local and .venv are excluded.
Proposed v2/v3 tag URLs are not verified published releases or assigned immutable identifiers.
No Git initialization, commit, tag, ZIP, seal, push or publication was performed.
All pre-existing body text, tables, media, eight other manuscripts and historical records remain unchanged.
